guesses.reason: Small size, large upright triangular ears, rounded apple-ish skull, and short muzzle with big dark eyes are classic Chihuahua traits.
Dark brindle coat with a white chest blaze, white muzzle stripe, and erect bat-like ears suggest Boston Terrier influence.
The sleek short coat, fine legs, and alert erect ears fit a Min Pin contribution.

breed.appearance: A small, fine-boned dog with a short, dark black-brindle coat, a white chest patch, a thin white stripe on the chin and a white dab at the top of the nose, plus one fully white front paw and lower leg while the other front paw is dark with a little white on the toes. He has very large, upright, pointed triangular ears, a rounded head, a short tapered muzzle with light grizzled gray around the lips, and round, dark brown, soulful eyes. He wears a bright blue collar with a silver bone-shaped tag and has a slim, long black tail.
breed.fun_fact: Chihuahuas are the world's smallest dog breed but carry giant personalities and fierce loyalty to their favorite people!
